headline: Pre-IPO Derivative Traders Value Reliance Jio at $110 Billion on Bitget
summary: Pre-IPO contracts for India's telecom leader Reliance Jio traded around $12 on the Bitget exchange, reflecting an implied valuation of roughly $110 billion as its public offering remained open for subscription.
why: Reliance Jio, the telecom division of Reliance Industries, is India's largest wireless operator with major digital services exposure.

impacts.name: Reliance Industries
impacts.why: A strong premium in pre-IPO pricing reflects robust investor demand for the conglomerate's telecom arm.
